query: 我在做一个项目管理工具，用户点“发布”后按钮和右侧的版本记录都要有反馈。帮我把整个产品瞬间设计出来。
卡片出现时我想要有一点从外面进来的感觉，最后收得很干净。这个该选什么动效？
这段 React 动画总是卡顿，用户连续点击时状态还会倒退。请帮我 review 动效逻辑和 CSS。
给我一个 HTML CSS JS 的上传完成反馈，要有失败重试和减少动态效果的处理。
我想把“删除后撤销”这个交互贡献到 Motion Lexicon，候选需要怎么写？
商品缩略图进详情页时 shared element、morph、crossfade 怎么选？
帮我把这张产品截图裁成小红书封面尺寸，再把文字锐化一点。
我想录一条介绍开源项目的视频，帮我写 45 秒口播稿和标题。
帮我把首页标题改得更有吸引力，目标是让用户知道这是免费的开源项目。
请给这个 SQLite 表增加一个 created_at 索引，并解释迁移步骤。
I am designing a checkout confirmation where payment can fail, retry, and succeed. Compose the interaction and its accessible motion states.
Summarize this customer interview transcript into the five strongest product insights and include direct evidence for each one.
Review this animation: it changes top, left, width, blur, and shadow for 600ms, then flashes when the user hovers quickly.
Build the core React interaction for a selectable project card that opens a side panel and handles Escape, focus, and reduced motion.
I have a reusable status-to-next-action pattern from three products. Help me prepare it as a Motion Lexicon primitive candidate.
Plan a four-day Kyoto itinerary for two people who care about architecture, coffee, and easy public transit.
Please clean this CSV, calculate retention by month, and create a summary table for the finance team.
Can you rewrite our privacy policy paragraph in plainer English while preserving the legal meaning?
Our Node server returns 502 after a deploy. Help me inspect the logs and identify the broken environment variable.
Make the pricing table fit on a 390px viewport with two columns and consistent spacing.
在现有 React 项目里完整实现一个项目总览 Dashboard，包含指标、风险列表、最近活动和新建项目流程，并按现有设计系统做好移动端和深色模式。
请做一个完整的团队设置页：成员、角色、待邀请用户和 SSO 状态都要有，邀请成员的成功和失败状态也要实现。
把现有账单页的用量卡片标题改成“本月用量”，只调整这行文案，不改页面结构和交互。
把现有仪表盘左侧栏在 768px 以下隐藏，其他页面内容、样式和交互都保持原样。

Build a complete React landing page for our developer tool with a hero, interactive product demo, pricing, FAQ, and signup path. Preserve the project system and verify responsive, dark-mode, keyboard, and reduced-motion behavior.
Implement the full support inbox route in our app: filters, conversation list, ticket detail, reply composer, and resolved state. Inspect the existing codebase before choosing the components.
Change the heading on the existing onboarding page from 'Get started' to 'Set up your workspace'; leave layout, components, and behavior untouched.
Update the existing dashboard's muted text color token to meet contrast requirements. Do not change routes, page structure, or interactions.
